title: Effectiveness of Homeopathic Treatment in Female Infertility
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the effectiveness of Homoeopathic treatment in female infertility.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Inclusion criteria:

  * Only female causes
  * Age group of 18-40 years
  * Cases of PCOS, Endometriosis and Chronic PID
  * Primary and secondary infertility

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age group below 18 years and beyond 40 years
* All other causes such as unknown infertility, congenital defects
* Women whose husband's semen analysis is abnormal
